Create your first application

Start with a simple chatbot, then add your organization’s knowledge.

Before you begin

Sign in to ai-studio.xdev.asia with an account that can create applications in your workspace. A workspace administrator must configure an available model provider. If you cannot see a create or publish action, ask your administrator to check your permissions.

Create and configure

  1. Open the applications page and choose the action to create an application.
  2. Choose Chatbot under the basic application types for this first example. Give it a recognizable name and create it.
  3. In the application editor, select an available model and enter instructions. For example: “Help colleagues understand the supplied procedure. If information is missing, say so.”
  4. Save your draft before testing or publishing.

Try a focused example

  1. Open the preview and ask a question related to your instructions.
  2. Check whether the answer follows the instructions. Try an unclear question and a question the application cannot answer.
  3. Refine the instructions and save the draft again. Add a knowledge base if the application needs your documents.

What comes next

A saved draft is not a published application. Follow the publishing guide when your tests are satisfactory. For a multi-step process, create a Workflow application instead.
